label: strategist for institution
definition: Person X explicitly serves or served as a strategist for institution or principal Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit strategist-at, strategist-for, or institutional strategist role; historical strategy office. Excludes: analyst or ordinary adviser alone; a comparison or strategy topic without affiliation; ordinary employment without strategist role. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear principal versus topic; strategist title attachment unresolved. A distinct occupational role; do not merge every analyst or adviser into it.
